author: Praxis V
title: EtC+BRBG‑minimal v5j: Cosine eq‑quota with rotated remainders (λ_r=0.64, k=50, kq=512)
abstract: Fixed-candidate cosine equal‑quota graph with per-row rotated remainder allocation to avoid bias (k=50 not divisible by 4). Uses EtC embedding (PCA60→ComBat) and BRBG residualization (λ_r=0.64) on graph PCs. Binary symmetric connectivities, true distances; neighbors metadata set.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from integration_utils import normalize_log1p_counts, select_features, pca_svd, ridge_residualize_per_pc, set_neighbors_meta
from eq_quota_utils import eq_quota_knn_cosine

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Preprocess + HVGs
    Xn = normalize_log1p_counts(adata)
    Xn = select_features(Xn, adata)

    # Embedding (EtC)
    Z_emb = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=60, random_state=0)
    ad_pca = ad.AnnData(X=Z_emb.copy(), obs=adata.obs[['batch']].copy())
    sc.pp.combat(ad_pca, key='batch')
    X_emb = np.asarray(ad_pca.X, dtype=np.float32)

    # Graph (cosine eq‑quota, kq=512, rotated remainders)
    Zg = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=50, random_state=1)
    Zg_corr = ridge_residualize_per_pc(Zg, adata.obs['batch'].values, lam_r=0.64, l2=1e-3)
    C, D = eq_quota_knn_cosine(Zg_corr, batches=adata.obs['batch'].values, k=50, k_candidates=512, metric='cosine', remainder_mode='rotate')

    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = X_emb
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    set_neighbors_meta(adata, k=50, method='eq_quota_rotated+ridge_resid', metric='cosine',
                       extra={'k_candidates': 512, 'lam_r': 0.64})
    return adata
